images.title: Matchstick triangles grow
images.purpose: Show that each step of the triangle pattern adds 2 matchsticks to the one before.
images.composition: Three steps of the pattern side by side in one row, with +2 arrows between them and the counts beneath; white space above.
exact_structure: Three pictures in a row left to right, each a strip of triangles made of matchsticks: Step 1 is 1 triangle (3 sticks), Step 2 is 2 triangles side by side sharing one stick (5 sticks), Step 3 is 3 triangles side by side (7 sticks).

In Step 1 all 3 sticks are teal #0072B2; in Step 2 the 3 sticks carried over are teal and the 2 newly added sticks are amber #E69F00; in Step 3 the 5 carried over are teal and the 2 newly added are amber #E69F00.
Under each picture its step name and count: "Step 1" with "3", "Step 2" with "5", "Step 3" with "7".
Between neighbouring pictures one small grey #6B7280 arrow labelled "+2" (2 arrows in all).
No Step 4 or Step 5, no formula.
rejection: any step with a stick count other than 3, 5 and 7
the added sticks not exactly 2 per step
images.takeaway: Every step adds 2 matchsticks, which lets us jump to any far step.
images.description: Matchstick triangle strips for Steps 1, 2 and 3 with 3, 5 and 7 sticks and an arrow +2 between each step.
images.context: Shown beside the matchstick pattern text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Spot the two amber sticks added at each step before predicting Step 5.

image_decisions.why: Colouring the new sticks makes the constant addition of 2 visible.
